Thanks for the note and for the attachment. I can escalate this to our compliance/forensics team, but to speed review we need a couple of clarifications up front:

1) Can you confirm the exact time range of logs you need preserved (start/end timestamps) and whether you mean application-level request/response traces, inference KV cache snapshots, or both?
